name: Tomas Arvel
bio: Arvel fires while the ground is still moving under him. The misses are expensive. The hits are why Kestrel keeps paying.

personality.label: Daring show-off
personality.description: Chases difficult shots and an appreciative audience. Laughs when nervous; hates letting the team down.

move: A little room for style. Moving.
attack: Let us make the expensive shot count.
Moving target, moving shooter. My kind of problem.
guard: Holding the pose. Do try to appreciate it.
investigate: Off to meet the mystery guest.
heavy_fire: Audience is getting hostile! Cover me.
That is enough applause from their guns. I need a hand.
